purpose: Versioned inventory of accuracy benchmark sources, evidence roles, known baselines, and mandatory per-run metadata.

metric_contract.precision: Independently confirmed true-positive findings divided by all adjudicated in-scope findings, weighted to the declared target population.
metric_contract.recall: Independently confirmed in-scope benchmark defects detected by Arbiter divided by all independently confirmed in-scope benchmark defects.
metric_contract.matching: Use the evaluator's versioned file, location-tolerance, weakness/category, and duplicate rules; record the evaluator revision with every run.
metric_contract.uncertainty: Report a 95% lower confidence bound with a repository-cluster-aware method validated for the sampling design; do not treat findings from one repository as independent observations.
metric_contract.incomplete_label_or_applicability_covera: Report separately and never assume an unlabelled, unrun, or unsupported stratum passed.

sampling_frame.source: GitHub repository search metadata via gh search repos

eligibility_rules: Require a non-empty repository description and a description or repository name indicating a Python library, framework, package, client, server, application, developer tool, parser, database, CLI, API, scheduler, inventory system, monitoring tool, or plotting library.

Exclude benchmark and dataset projects, tutorials and courseware, security-focused tools, AI/LLM and model projects, research projects, bots and consumer/social automation, and other non-ordinary software categories.
Apply these rules to repository names and public descriptions before drawing; retain the resulting eligible frame and its original popularity order.

selection.method: Python random.Random(seed).sample over the ordered eligible repository list
selection.ordering: Eligible repositories retain their order in the popularity-sorted GitHub metadata frame.

metadata_sources: selected repository identifiers in the RealVuln source entry of this manifest

scan_run.matching_contract: Within each repository, normalize repository-relative paths and count findings as location-overlapping only when inclusive line spans intersect. Count CWE-tag intersection separately. A finding pair is counted once per pair of findings; one-to-many overlaps are possible. Do not infer vulnerability identity or correctness from location or CWE agreement.
limits: This is descriptive differential coverage on a small popularity-biased convenience sample, not probability-sampled production accuracy.
Analyzer totals are not comparable correctness scores: the tools use different rules, categories, language coverage, ignore behavior, and extraction semantics.
Semgrep scanned 2,146 of 3,662 Python files, with 8 parser/rule errors (7 timeouts and 1 syntax error); its ignore rules exclude additional files.
CodeQL scanned 3,661 of 3,662 Python files. It emitted 189 extractor warning lines: repeated dynamic-library path warnings and two module-context warnings.
Arbiter ran only its lang_python probe, so all 11 overall scorecards were withheld at 8.1 percent total assessment coverage; this is not a low grade.
The location/CWE matcher is only a differential aid; 39 Arbiter/Semgrep location-overlap pairs and zero observed CodeQL overlaps do not establish true or false findings.
No precision-sample labels, independent human adjudication, repository miss audit, or rule tuning were performed.

review_prerequisites: A coordinator independent of Arbiter rule authors must blind packets and select the review sample before labels are produced.
Independent human adjudication remains unavailable; model labels, if later used under the approved interim design, must be reported only as model-labelled conformance.
Finding precision sampling and the separate blind repository miss audit are distinct follow-up studies.
limits: This is a seeded convenience sample drawn from a popularity-sorted, MIT-filtered top-100 GitHub search frame, not a probability sample of production repositories.
The cohort contains 11 repository clusters, all Python, and cannot support population-wide accuracy, recall, or 99 percent certification.
Pinned source archives were acquired and scanned without executing project code; raw archives, scan reports, databases, and case-level findings were kept in temporary storage and are not committed.

selection_gates: Confirm a sufficiently large Python CWE-89 subset using metadata only.
Review licenses and provenance of every selected source repository and code excerpt.
Keep development examples separate from the final benchmark population.
Treat automatically derived patch labels as noisy; report only CVEfixes benchmark conformance, not general detection accuracy.

candidate_sources.license_method: GitHub license metadata queried at each selected source commit; only MIT and Unlicense source repositories are included.
candidate_sources.label_provenance: All 60 selected CWE-89 entries have evidence.source=manual_review; 5 explicitly set manually_verified=true and 55 omit that flag. The labels are benchmark-maintainer evidence, not an independently audited or multi-reviewer ground truth.
candidate_sources.matching_contract: Case-level classification by repository-relative file, acceptable CWE (including CWE-89), and line-span overlap within the benchmark's +/-10-line tolerance. Unmatched CWE-89 findings remain unassessed and are excluded from labelled-case precision.
candidate_sources.uncertainty_method: Seeded repository-cluster bootstrap percentile intervals; descriptive stability within this curated subset only, not production-population confidence bounds.

evaluation_run.scan_command_template: PYTHONPATH=src uv run --no-project --with PyYAML --with tree-sitter-language-pack==1.22.1 python -c 'from arbiter.cli import main; main()' scan <source> --config <offline-config> --profile offline --only lang_python --no-adapters --no-cache --no-history --no-open --format json --out <reports>/<repo-id>

cluster_bootstrap.interpretation: Descriptive stability within this curated 11-repository benchmark subset only; not an interval for production repositories or a 99% certification.

evaluation_run.claim_scope: RealVuln 3.1.0 approved Python CWE-89 case-level conformance only; not Arbiter finding precision or production-population accuracy.

multi_cwe_label_inventory.label_limit: Benchmark-maintainer evidence; manual_review is not independent multi-reviewer adjudication.

multi_cwe_evaluation_run.claim_scope: Curated RealVuln 3.1.0 11-repository Python manual-review case conformance; not independently adjudicated truth, finding-level precision, or production-population accuracy.

coverage.file_set_difference: CodeQL extracted 459/459 Python files. Semgrep scanned 360 Python and 558 non-Python files while applying each source repository's .semgrepignore; tool-level file sets therefore differ.

analyzer_differential_run.matching_contract: Within each repository, normalize repository-relative Python paths and count findings as location-overlapping only when their inclusive line spans intersect. Report pairwise finding pairs and the number of findings with at least one counterpart; count CWE-tag intersection separately. Matching is not deduplicated to vulnerabilities, and one-to-many overlaps are possible.
limits: The cohort is the intentionally vulnerable RealVuln benchmark subset, not ordinary or representative production repositories.
Differential overlap, unmatched findings, and CWE-tag concordance are not ground truth, precision, recall, or false-positive rates.
The tools use different rule semantics and effective file sets; Semgrep applied source .semgrepignore files.
Arbiter was run with native probes only to keep its own Semgrep adapter from duplicating the separately pinned Semgrep scan.
Only aggregate results are committed. Source archives, databases, and case-level analyzer reports were temporary and are not included.
No rules were tuned on these evaluation snapshots; no human or model labels were produced for this differential run.
This does not measure ordinary-repository precision, missed-defect recall, or cross-platform accuracy.

selection_gates: Use only the 11 selected Python source repositories whose license metadata is MIT or Unlicense at the exact pinned source commit; exclude GPL-3.0 and NOASSERTION repositories.
The benchmark manifest and ground-truth metadata are pinned to commit 7a710251f55c17d32d3adcb13d37468e2e3b9e4a.
Run only offline lang_python scans with adapters, network, cache, and history disabled; retain no source code or per-example report in the repository.
Emit aggregate-only case-level metrics; do not tune rules on this public benchmark or claim production-population accuracy.
limits: All targets are intentionally vulnerable applications, not a representative production-repository sample.
The selected subset has only 11 repository clusters and 60 labels; it cannot establish a general 99 percent precision or recall claim.
Labels use manual_review evidence, but only 5 of 60 selected entries are explicitly flagged manually_verified; independent multi-reviewer audit is not documented.
Only labelled cases contribute to case-level precision; unmatched CWE-89 alerts are reported as unassessed, not assumed false positives.
The 35 NOASSERTION and 3 GPL-3.0 source repositories are excluded.
